text_block_list.text:
"The world was entirely wrapped up in Christmas colors.
It was on the way back from a shopping trip in town
with Admire Groove."
Oh...? Aren't you... Admire Groove?
An elderly woman I didn't know called out to me.

"How nostalgic...
I'm so glad to see you're doing well."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Principal?
Before coming to Tracen Academy, Admire Groove lived in a children's home. Apparently, this elderly lady was the director there.

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text:
She has been a truly brilliant child ever since she was little.
She picked up everything even without us teaching her.
We used to talk about how she might end up a scholar, but then—

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text: Eventually, you became faster than anyone else at running. And now, you're shining so brightly in major races.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I simply... honed my own aptitudes.

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You've had that vibe since way back when.
Though—

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text:
Has the look in your eyes softened a bit?
You must have met some wonderful people.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that... really how it is...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Though...
there may have been quite a few meddlesome people around.

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
And so, is everyone on the staff
doing well?

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they're all doing their best.
No matter the era, there are always children who come to the home due to various circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text: With the recession and all, there are times when we can't buy the kids everything they want, but—

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we have to protect this facility.
To connect those kids to their futures.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
To be honest... leaving you behind was one of my few regrets.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text: "She's a brilliant girl, so I knew she'd do just fine on her own. But still..."

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text:
Just because she was a "child who could do anything on her own," I ended up leaving her all alone... 
I've felt that way for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I am... deeply grateful to the director and all the staff.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: For raising me... and for sending me off... so that I could walk down this path.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: My study supplies... and sports gear, too... The director and staff provided all of it, which is why I am who I am today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, even for Christmas presents, it happened a few times...

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text: Ah... Fufu. Even if you don't show it on your face, I knew you cherished me.

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text:
...When things like that happen,
it really makes me glad I kept doing this job.

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to seeing
the children's smiles this year too.

text_block_list.name: Orphanage Director
text_block_list.text: Well then... please take care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
The director as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(The children that the director and teachers
are trying to protect...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I was... among them too, wasn't I...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I'd like to do
a bit of additional shopping, if that's all right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Please let me go to the shopping mall.
I looked after the departing kindergarten director. I felt like I understood what she wanted to do.
Afterward, we went around everywhere and bought plenty of toys and study supplies.

Judging by the target age group,
it's likely meant for the children at the facility.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll give a cake as a present, then.
Maybe I'll gift a cake, then.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You don't have any connection
to the facility, do you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: It's out of respect for the director who raised and protected you.
It's out of respect for the director who protected and raised you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
......Is that so.
Then please, do as you wish.
choice_data_list: I hope the children grow up happy.
I hope the children grow up happy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

Later on, a thank-you letter and photos arrived
in response to the gifts sent to the facility.
Seeing the smiles of the children now living in her old home, her expression seemed somewhat gentler, if only slightly.

I got carried away and bought an extravagant cake too.
Having it tonight will make for a better memory for the kids
than having a frozen one delivered later.

With that thought in mind, we canceled the delivery
and decided to bring it directly to the facility.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You didn't have to come along, Trainer...
It takes quite a while to get to the facility, you know?
choice_data_list: I just really had to be Santa today, you know.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see.
In that case, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Here I go.

Under the night sky illuminated by shimmering city lights,
I walked alongside Admire Groove, carrying heavy bags.
In the distance, the sound of a bell was ringing—
